description: This PHP file defines an API class 'CurrentDateTimeAPI' within the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin. It provides an endpoint to retrieve the current date and time, using internal services and models. The class extends a base 'Endpoint' class and implements the 'ResourceEndpoint' interface, utilizing traits and various dependencies to enforce validation and response structure.
